subject: Post-demo: Security follow-up & pen test / vuln management details
messages:

Date: 2026-03-22T15:04:00Z
Subject: Post-demo: Security follow-up & pen test / vuln management details

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the product demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Redwood is SOC 2 Type II in scope at the control level for our hosted control plane; our Dedicated offering has additional controls for customer isolation (happy to share the SOC report under NDA).
- We support GDPR data processing agreements and have optional contractual clauses for data residency. For HIPAA we offer BAAs for eligible customers — will need to validate scope with legal.

Action items I promised on the call:
1) Send over the vendor security questionnaire we filled out for your review.
2) Provide our latest pen test summary and an overview of our vulnerability management SLAs and scanning cadence.
3) Schedule a short security deep-dive with our security lead (Neha) — 30 minutes.

I attached the completed questionnaire and will follow up once I have the pen test summary ready to share via secure link. Would you prefer a signed NDA prior to SOC 2 or pen test delivery, or is an initial summary sufficient?

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
[Attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Filled.xlsx]

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. A few clarifying questions from our security team before we schedule the deep-dive: 

- Can you confirm whether the SOC 2 report includes the physical and logical access controls for the hosted environment, or is it limited to the control plane only?
- Do you maintain a documented vulnerability disclosure policy and an internal SLA for critical/urgent findings? If so, what are your target time-to-remediation windows (P1/P2/P3)?
- For pen tests: do you provide the full report or only an executive summary to prospects? Any restrictions we should be aware of (NDA, redaction)?

Looping in Sophie (security) — Sophie, we may ask for the pen test summary and a statement on scanning cadence and remediation SLAs.

Alex
Director of IT, Finex Capital
a.johnson@finex.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <a.johnson@finex.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-23T09:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Security follow-up & pen test / vuln management details

Hi Alex / Sophie —

Thanks — answers below and attaching the questionnaire we completed for your records. 

- SOC 2: Our SOC 2 Type II covers the hosted control plane and the services Redwood operates to serve API traffic (logical access, change management, monitoring). For Dedicated/private deployments we can scope controls and provide an addendum; we typically share the SOC 2 report under NDA (we can start with an executive summary if that speeds things up).

- Pen test reports: We generally provide an executive summary to prospects and customers. Full technical reports are shared under a mutual NDA and on a need-to-know basis. We completed an internal third-party penetration test in 2025; I'll request the summary from security now and circulate it via a secure link.

- Vulnerability management: high-level SLA targets we operate to are below (internal targets, published for customers):
  * P1 (critical): initial triage within 4 hours, mitigation or rollout within 72 hours where feasible;
  * P2 (high): initial triage within 24 hours, remediation within 14 days (depending on risk and workaround availability);
  * P3 (medium): remediation within 30-90 days depending on backlog and risk.

- Scanning cadence and detection: we run weekly automated authenticated network and application scans, continuous SCA for deps, and quarterly third-party pen tests. Critical hotfixes are triaged immediately with out-of-band releases as needed.

Next steps:
- Sophie, would you like the SOC 2 executive summary first or should we exchange an NDA to get the full SOC 2 and the 2025 pen test technical report?
- If you want a technical deep-dive, Neha is available for a 30-minute session — propose a couple of windows and we'll book.

Thanks,

Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Filled.xlsx]

Appreciate the quick answers and the questionnaire. For our procurement and InfoSec review, we need the following: 

1) SOC 2 executive summary now; full report under NDA.
2) Pen test executive summary now; full technical report under NDA — please include date and scope of the assessment.
3) A one-page statement of your vulnerability disclosure policy and whether you maintain a public or private process for external researchers.
4) Confirmation of scanning cadence (you listed weekly + quarterly pen tests) and whether authenticated scans are run against dedicated instances for Dedicated customers.

If you can send items 1-3 today or tomorrow that would help speed procurement. You can send the pen test executive summary as a PDF or secure link.

Thanks,

Sophie Lee
